questions.markdown: A tensile load of 40 kN is acting on rod of 40 mm diameter and length of 4m. Take $E = 2 \times 10^5$ N/mm$^2$.

A specimen of steel 25 mm diameter with a gauge length of 250 mm is tested to destruction. It has an extension of 0.30 mm under a load of 95 kN and the load at elastic limit is 117 kN. The ultimate load is 145 kN.

The total extension at fracture is 60 mm, diameter at neck is 20 mm and, diameter at fracture is 16 mm. Find

(i) Breaking stress. (ii) True breaking stress. (iii) Percentage elongation. (iv) Percentage reduction in area. (v) Ultimate tensile stress.
Derive the relationship between Young's modulus $(E)$ and Bulk modulus $(K)$.
Draw and explain shear stress and shear strain.
